key_insight: RSI-Anything turns interaction experience into persistent gains by using predictive world models to choose better actions, select learning data, and retain only compatible policy-model updates.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a domain-general path for improving agents and workflows in code repair, GUIs, scientific planning, and reaction optimization without relying solely on expensive external feedback.
method: Use a JEPA-Anything-based predictive world model to forecast outcomes and guide selection.
Update policies or workflows from observed feedback, then conditionally adapt the world model.
Apply component and compatibility checks before retaining updated policy-model pairs.
evidence_signal: Across benchmarks, RSI-Anything improved code-repair success from 26.3% to 31.2%, cut GUI actions by 39.4%, raised lab-planning scores from 21.80% to 46.01%, and reached 96.15% mean best observed yield in reaction optimization under a 40-experiment budget.
watch_item: Because the world model can drift as policies evolve, performance depends on careful compatibility checks and controlled adaptation to avoid compounding prediction errors.
paper_title: RSI-Anything: Unlocking Recursive Self-Improvement with World Models
